name: Deploy marimo dashboard to GitHub Pages

on:
  push:
    branches: ["main"]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pages: write
  id-token: write

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v5

      - name: Install Python
        run: uv python install

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --locked

      - name: Export marimo app to WASM HTML
        run: |
          mkdir -p site/dashboards/airbnb
          uv run marimo export html-wasm additional_material/Dashboards/airbnbdashboard.py \
            -o site/dashboards/airbnb \
            --mode run
          touch site/.nojekyll

      - name: Upload Pages artifact
        uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: site

  deploy:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment:
      name: github-pages
    steps:
      - name: Deploy to GitHub Pages
        uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
